svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif

title.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.title: The same pipeline for any vertical with just two files

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.desc: The entry workflow runs the shared scripts while passing the vertical value, and the shared scripts read that vertical's config file to operate. Adding a new vertical takes only two files — an entry workflow and a config — with no change to the shared scripts.

svg.text: The same pipeline for any vertical with just two files

text.style: fill:rgb(102, 102, 102);stroke:none;color:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.text: Shared scripts stay fixed — each vertical only adds an entry workflow and a config file
